title: Run a local chat on the old PC
summary: Ollama + a small model over SSH. Stays on the house network. Don't buy a GPU this weekend.

start.body: Install Ollama on the old PC, pull a small model, chat from SSH. Answers stay on the house network. CPU is fine for a first try.

check.body: Check RAM and disk first: free -h and df -h ~. Aim for ~8 GB RAM for a small 1B–3B model and a few free GB on disk. 4 GB boxes can try the 1B tag, slowly.

disk.body: Park the share on a USB that stays plugged in first. Free room, then come back to install Ollama.

install.body: Official install: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh — or download, less it, then bash. Check: ollama -v and systemctl is-active ollama.

pull.body: Start tiny: ollama pull llama3.2:1b. About 8 GB free and patience? ollama pull llama3.2 (3B). List with ollama list.

chat.body: ollama run llama3.2:1b — type a short question, wait (CPU is slow on first load), /bye to leave. Keep port 11434 off the open internet. Skip Open WebUI and GPUs tonight.
